units.rawText: Why am I still using this old-fashioned foldable cellphone, you ask?
units.displayText: Why am I still using this old-fashioned foldable cellphone, you ask?

spans.text: Why am I still using this old-fashioned foldable cellphone, you ask?

units.rawText: Of course it's because I like this! The feeling of real buttons under my fingers is irresistible! It feels super comfortable whether I'm typing or playing mobile games, and nowadays these foldable phones are quite intelligent too! You're really wrong to think it's only for the elderly.
